faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RCFL Advisor - Secretarial post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the RCFL Advisor - Secretarial post is 07-09-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criterion for the Advisor - Secretarial position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates with working knowledge of Shorthand and Microsoft Office. They should have superannuated from a minimum Manager-Secretarial position or above in RCF with at least 10 years of experience as a Secretary to senior executives.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data and attach all required documents, then send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Advisor - Secretarial post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Advisor - Secretarial position is 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Advisor - Secretarial role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a lump sum remuneration equivalent to 80% of their last drawn Basic Pay plus Dearness Allowance (DA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Advisor - Secretarial post will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents do I need to attach with my application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of your educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Advisor - Secretarial position is Contractual.
